reviews.title: Update is horrible
reviews.text: I have bought this app 3 times on 3 different Apple IDs. I’ve used it for almost the entire time it’s been around. The last update is so bad, it keeps telling me to sync and nobody is using this “style expert” tab… I deleted it after almost a decade of use

reviews.title: Total waste
reviews.text:
I spent hours entering photos of my wardrobe only to find out that I put the looks together. 
No help from the app. 
I wasted my time. I don’t need the app to do it all myself.

reviews.title: Not to help you style outfits
reviews.text: I thought this was suppose to help you style your outfits and it doesnt the hype was a let down

reviews.title: Wrong app for Men. Look for "Stylebook Men" instead.
reviews.text: Purchased this to start tracking my closet, but saw  several typically female-gendered categories such as "dresses" and "heels" but missing typically male-gendered categories like "suits" or "dress shoes". Couldn't find an option to change category names or add new ones, or an option in settings that would switch. Upon further research there's another app called "Stylebook Men" that has these categories but is a separate app with a separate purchase.  Unfortunately it seems that Apple doesn't allow refunds for this app.
